items.quote: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,
items.claim: They brought the tabernacle and its furniture components to Moses
items.object: the tabernacle, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets

items.quote: And the covering of rams' skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers' skins, and the vail of the covering,
items.claim: The tabernacle had coverings made of rams' skins dyed red and badgers' skins with a vail
items.object: the covering of rams' skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers' skins, and the vail of the covering

items.quote: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,
items.claim: The tabernacle contained the ark of the testimony with staves and a mercy seat
items.object: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat

items.quote: The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,
items.claim: The tabernacle contained a table with vessels and shewbread
items.object: The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread

items.quote: The pure candlestick, with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,
items.claim: The tabernacle had a pure candlestick with lamps to be set in order, vessels, and oil for light
items.object: The pure candlestick, with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light

items.quote: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,
items.claim: The tabernacle included a golden altar, anointing oil, sweet incense, and a hanging for the door
items.object: the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door

items.quote: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
items.claim: The tabernacle had a brass altar with brass grate, staves, vessels, a laver and its foot
items.object: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot

items.quote: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,
items.claim: The tabernacle courtyard had hangings with pillars and sockets, a gate hanging with cords and pins, and service vessels
items.object: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation

items.quote: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons' garments, to minister in the priest's office.
items.claim: The tabernacle included service cloths and holy garments for Aaron the priest and his sons to perform priestly duties
items.object: The cloths of service and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons' garments
items.actor: Aaron the priest, and his sons
items.action: to do service in the holy place, to minister in the priest's office
